sn43.12:1.1: asaṅkhatañca vo bhikkhave desissāmi asaṅkhatagāmiñca maggaṃ
sn43.12:1.9: iti kho bhikkhave desitaṃ vo mayā asaṅkhataṃ desito asaṅkhatagāmimaggo.
sn43.12:1.10: yaṃ bhikkhave satthārā karaṇīyaṃ sāvakānaṃ hitesinā anukampakena anukampaṃ upādāya kataṃ vo taṃ mayā.
sn43.12:1.11: etāni bhikkhave rukkhamūlāni etāni suññāgārāni. jhāyatha bhikkhave mā pamādattha mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha. ayaṃ vo amhākaṃ anusāsanīti.
sn43.12:2.1: asaṅkhatañca vo bhikkhave desissāmi asaṅkhatagāmiñca maggaṃ
sn43.12:2.9: iti kho bhikkhave desitaṃ vo mayā asaṅkhataṃ …pe…
sn43.12:3.8: avitakko avicāro samādhi. ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave asaṅkhatagāmimaggo.
sn43.12:4.8: appaṇihito samādhi. ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave asaṅkhatagāmimaggo.
sn43.12:5.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn43.12:5.5: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati …pe…
sn43.12:5.8: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu citte cittānupassī viharati …pe…
sn43.12:5.11: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati …pe… ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave asaṅkhatagāmimaggo.
sn43.12:6.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
sn43.12:6.5: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
sn43.12:6.8: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ uppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati.
sn43.12:6.11: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati. ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave asaṅkhatagāmimaggo.
sn43.12:7.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti.
sn43.12:7.5: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu viriyasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti.
sn43.12:7.8: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu cittasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti.
sn43.12:7.11: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu vīmaṃsāsamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgataṃ iddhipādaṃ bhāveti. ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave asaṅkhatagāmimaggo.
sn43.12:8.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddhindriyaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn43.12:8.5: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu viriyindriyaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ …pe…
sn43.12:8.14: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu paññindriyaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave asaṅkhatagāmimaggo.
sn43.12:9.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu saddhābalaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ …pe…
sn43.12:9.14: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu paññābalaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave asaṅkhatagāmimaggo.
sn43.12:10.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu satisambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn43.12:10.10: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ. ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave asaṅkhatagāmimaggo.
sn43.12:11.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn43.12:11.15: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn43.12:11.17: iti kho bhikkhave desitaṃ vo mayā asaṅkhataṃ desito asaṅkhatagāmimaggo.
